description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Strong Heart Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Strong Heart Mode
description.text: After using Spear Squall three times, grants [Wind Ability +30% Boost 3], [Dualcast Wind 3] and [Instant Cast 3], grants [Damage Cap +10000 3] if 2+ III allies are alive, removed after triggering
